from.place: Proof, Step 2, sentence 'The complex $(j^*K)^\vee$ is a bounded complex of constructible flat sheaves, and tensoring a bounded flat constructible model of $j^*L$ ... gives one': termwise, the Hom sheaf from a locally split finite projective term into a flat constructible term is flat constructible.

title: Hom from a locally split lisse sheaf into a flat constructible sheaf
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring and $U$ a Noetherian scheme (locally Noetherian and quasi-compact). On the small étale site $U_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] let $A_U$ be the constant sheaf of rings [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf] and let $E,G$ be sheaves of $A_U$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Assume:

1. there is an étale covering $\{V_\alpha\to U\}_\alpha$ such that for each $\alpha$ the restriction $E|_{V_\alpha}$ is isomorphic to a direct summand of $A_{V_\alpha}^{\oplus t_\alpha}$ for some finite integer $t_\alpha\geq0$;
2. $G$ is flat, i.e. $-\otimes_{A_U}G$ [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product] is exact on $A_U$-module sheaves [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules], and constructible [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf].

Then the sheaf Hom $\mathcal Hom_{A_U}(E,G)$ [def-pur-sheaf-hom] is a flat and constructible sheaf of $A_U$-modules.
